name: Tom and Jerry: The Chuck Jones Collection
original_name: Tom and Jerry: The Chuck Jones Collection
overview: The third and final era of theatrical Tom and Jerry shorts, produced by Chuck Jones and his Sib Tower 12 Productions (later MGM Animation/Visual Arts) between 1963 and 1967. These 34 shorts restyled Tom and Jerry with Jones's distinctive character designs and comic timing, following the original Hanna-Barbera (1940–1958) and Gene Deitch (1960–1962) eras.
